experiments.name: reset-chain measurement
experiments.init: li.d $r4, -1; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr2, $r4; li.d $r5, 0; li.d $r6, -1
experiments.command: ./bench --unroll 4000 --iters 300 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, -1; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr2, $r4; li.d $r5, 0; li.d $r6, -1' --asm 'xvmod.du $xr0, $xr0, $xr2; xvpickve2gr.du $r4, $xr0, 0; and $r4, $r4, $r5; or $r4, $r4, $r6; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr0, $r4'
experiments.notes: Element-0 reset chain; the closure latency is cancelled by the calibration experiment.

experiments.name: vadd.b reset-helper baseline
experiments.init: li.d $r4, -1; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr2, $r4; li.d $r5, 0; li.d $r6, -1
experiments.command: ./bench --unroll 4000 --iters 300 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, -1; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr2, $r4; li.d $r5, 0; li.d $r6, -1' --asm 'xvadd.b $xr0, $xr0, $xr2; xvpickve2gr.du $r4, $xr0, 0; and $r4, $r4, $r5; or $r4, $r4, $r6; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr0, $r4'
experiments.notes: Same helper chain with vadd.b replacing the variable-latency operation.

latencies.notes: Data-dependent. Measured over 8 operand pairs; min 7 cycles at 0/1, max 27 cycles at 18446744073709551615/1. The sample experiment uses the max-latency pair. Latency is derived by subtracting the same closure around vadd.b (calibration experiment).

throughput.notes: Data-dependent. CPI ranges 4.5 to 14.49 over the same operand pairs; the stored experiment uses 18446744073709551615/1.

notes: Vector variable-latency divide/modulo. Latency 7-27 cycles and throughput CPI 4.5-14.49 are data-dependent. The vector divider is a separate unit from the scalar one and completes a 64-bit lane divide in a shorter, fixed pipeline (~25 cycles here versus 38-39 for the scalar div), so the vector latency range is narrower than the scalar range even though the operand values are the same. This asymmetry also reproduces on LA664 (38 scalar versus 26 vector).
